ranking_metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations (max over binary packages built from the source package)
uncertainty: Pilot cell: five C paths verified, c-ares, ldns, knot (libknot), udns and getdns, ranked by Debian popcon sourcemax installations from the pinned table; every C lead with a positive primary metric and a documented bytes API is now selected. getdns bundles gldns (Unbound's sldns, ldns lineage), but its own decoder files share 75 of 3,228 distinct normalized source lines (2.3%) with ldns 1.8.4, so it is kept as a distinct package API with the lineage stated. Round 2 added targeted lookups for further debian-source:dns and conan:dns hits (registry-snapshot.json round2_targeted): libmicrodns, libjdns and djbdns are excluded (no documented message-bytes API or no library), as are adns, unbound, bind9, libevent and libspf2 from round 1; dnsjit (popcon 4) stays unresolved because its parser is a Lua module inside the dnsjit engine with no linkable C library; Conan-only mdns and pro-mdnsd have no primary metric. glibc libresolv ns_initparse/ns_parserr is verified on both controls as a standard/runtime path (not instrumented, no AFL++ feedback, outside the ranking); musl was not run. c-ares, ldns and udns drop the reserved Z bit (z carries AD and CD); knot and getdns report all three bits. Harness-side RDATA formatting (lower-casing, joining the MX preference and exchange) is disclosed per path. Each verified path parses the two valid controls (a query and a response with compressed CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers) to the hand-written oracle summary, has library source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback that differs between the controls. Two valid controls do not establish EDNS0, DNSSEC, TXT, authority/additional or malformed-input behaviour. Popcon counts are package-level, include non-DNS use and are small below c-ares; the cell is not a definitive top ten.
selection: Five control-verified C DNS path(s), ranked by Debian popcon sourcemax installations (max over binary packages built from the source package): c-ares 1.34.9 (43,027), ldns 1.8.4 (1,240), knot 3.6.2 (483), udns 0.7 (463), getdns 1.7.3 (118).
